correctness.rationale: PASS: The idempotent equation in the specified evolution basis is x=A^T x^[2]. For invertible M=A^T, classical Lang/semilinear normal form M=B(B^[2])^-1 over the algebraic closure turns fixed points into B(F2^n), exactly 2^n geometric idempotents. Frobenius_q descent C=B^-1 B^[q] lies in GL_n(F2) and counts rational idempotents as 2^dim ker(C-I). A rational twisted-conjugacy orbit of M corresponds to a binary conjugacy class [C] and has stabilizer |Z_GL_n(F2)(C)|; hence uniform M produces the uniform binary matrix C conjugacy-class law. Möbius inversion on binary subspace lattice gives N_{n,k}= [n choose k]_2 Σ_{j=0}^{n-k}(-1)^j 2^{j choose 2}[n-k choose j]_2 2^{(k+j)(n-k-j)}|GL_{n-k-j}(F2)|. Independently enumerated all invertible binary matrices n=1,2,3: fixed-point count histograms respectively {2:1}, {1:2,2:3,4:1}, {1:48,2:98,4:21,8:1}. These agree with the formula; all extension degrees and n follow from the proof, not finite tests.
